VINOD NAGARADDI

Product Owner | Business Analyst | Data-Driven Strategist

+91 72593 12629 | nagaraddivinod@gmail.com

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Product Owner / Business Analyst with 6+ years of progressive experience translating complex business needs into clear, actionable requirements and high-impact product features.

Proven expertise in end-to-end product lifecycle management, from discovery and requirements gathering to delivery and post-launch optimization.

Strong experience working across Agile/Scrum and Waterfall methodologies, collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.

Domain expertise in EdTech ERP systems (UUCMS) and AI / Chatbot development, delivering scalable and user-centric solutions.

Highly skilled in requirements documentation, including FRS, SRS, BRD, user stories, and acceptance criteria.

Adept at data analysis and data-driven decision-making, leveraging insights to improve product outcomes and stakeholder satisfaction.

Experienced in creating process flows, wireframes, screen designs, and functional flowcharts to support development teams.

Strong stakeholder and client management skills, ensuring alignment between business objectives and technical implementation.

Known for driving cross-functional collaboration, improving delivery efficiency, and ensuring high-quality user experiences.

CORE COMPETENCIES & TECHNICAL SKILLS

Product & Project Management: SDLC, Agile Methodology, Scrum Framework, Waterfall Model, Product Backlog Management, Requirement Prioritization, Stakeholder Management, User Stories, Feature Definition, Wireframing, UAT Planning & Execution, Manual Testing, Exposure to Automation Testing, Solution Delivery

Business Analysis: Requirement Gathering & Elicitation, FRS & SRS Documentation, Business Process Mapping (BPMN), Use Case Analysis, Functional & Non-Functional Requirements, Data Analysis, Critical Thinking, Problem Solving, Presentation & Communication, Custom Technology Solutions, Unit & Regression Testing Support

Data, Analytics & Visualization: Power BI Dashboards, Data Modeling, Data Manipulation, Data Visualization, SQL, Kibana, Postman, Advanced Microsoft Excel & PowerPoint (Microsoft 365)

Tools & Platforms: JIRA, QMDB, Power BI, Microsoft Office 365, Project Management Tools

Certifications: Certified Agile Business Analysis, Business Analysis Master Class – Professional Certificate (Udemy)

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

CENTRE FOR SMART GOVERNANCE

Business Analyst | June 2022 – October 2025

Project: UUCMS – Unified University and College Management System (ERP)

Led end-to-end requirements gathering and analysis for a large-scale EdTech ERP platform serving universities and affiliated colleges, ensuring alignment between business needs and technical feasibility.

Collaborated closely with government stakeholders, academic institutions, product owners, architects, and development teams to translate complex requirements into FRS, SRS, user stories, and acceptance criteria.

Played a key role in feature definition, prioritization, and backlog grooming within Agile/Scrum teams, ensuring timely and high-quality delivery.

Supported the design and rollout of critical ERP modules, including Admissions, Asset Management, Library Management, Student Support System, and Academic Operations.

Conducted process mapping and gap analysis to streamline workflows and improve system usability across multiple user personas.

Coordinated UAT planning and execution, worked with end users to validate functionality, tracked defects, and ensured successful sign-off before production releases.

Worked closely with QA teams to support manual testing, regression testing, and validation of business scenarios.

Developed and delivered data analysis, dashboards, and reports using tools such as Power BI and Excel, enabling leadership to make data-driven decisions on system performance, adoption, and utilization.

Provided post-implementation support, gathered feedback from stakeholders, and contributed to continuous product improvement initiatives.

Maintained comprehensive project and requirements documentation while ensuring clear communication across cross-functional teams.

INTEL TECHNOLOGIES PVT. LTD.

ASIC Physical Designer – II | August 2021 – June 2022

Supported ASIC physical design and development teams by streamlining data operations, reporting, and project tracking within an Agile/Scrum delivery model.

Acted as a liaison between engineering teams, project managers, and stakeholders to monitor project health, identify risks, and support on-time delivery of quality milestones.

Leveraged JIRA and QMDB to extract and analyze critical project data, producing business analysis reports, KPIs, and performance dashboards that improved visibility across globally distributed teams.

Designed and maintained metrics and dashboards to track sprint progress, defect trends, workload distribution, and delivery readiness.

Maintained and continuously updated Wiki/Confluence documentation for development standards, workflows, and technical references to ensure knowledge continuity.

Managed and administered Agile sprint boards, ensuring accurate task tracking, backlog updates, and clear ownership for developers and testers.

Facilitated effective sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and sprint reviews by ensuring accurate data, status reporting, and action tracking.

Contributed to improved team efficiency, transparency, and adherence to quality and delivery targets through structured reporting and process optimization.

ACCENTURE INDIA

Data Scientist (Chatbot Developer) | November 2020 – August 2021

Designed and enhanced AI-driven chatbot workflows by pre-processing large volumes of customer–agent interaction data and creating detailed conversation flowcharts using Lucid, significantly improving response accuracy and user experience.

Analyzed chatbot conversation logs and performance metrics to identify gaps, optimize dialogue logic, and improve intent recognition and response relevance.

Conducted quantitative and qualitative data analysis, translating complex datasets into actionable insights that guided stakeholders in prioritizing chatbot enhancements and performance improvements.

Collaborated with product owners, business stakeholders, developers, and QA teams to align chatbot functionality with business objectives and user needs.

Applied Agile/Scrum methodology throughout the development lifecycle, actively participating in sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily stand-ups, and sprint reviews.

Maintained sprint boards and task tracking, ensuring clear visibility of deliverables and timely achievement of development and testing goals.

Supported UAT and production readiness, validating chatbot flows against business scenarios and user expectations.

Contributed to continuous improvement initiatives by incorporating user feedback and analytics into chatbot optimization efforts.

Project 

Chatbot Development

Skills: Chatbot Development, Dialogflow CX, Artificial Intelligence, Natural Language Understanding (NLU)

Role & Responsibilities:

Pre-processed conversation data between customers and agents using NLP techniques and Excel for structured analysis.

Designed detailed flowcharts in Lucidchart to map conversation flows and chatbot interactions.

Developed, implemented, and tested chatbots using Dialogflow CX, ensuring accuracy of responses and alignment with designed conversation flows.

WIPRO LTD.

Senior Associate – Autonomous Vehicle Mapping | March 2017 – November 2020

Contributed to autonomous vehicle (AV) machine teaching initiatives by developing and validating high-precision map data used for self-driving car navigation and decision-making systems.

Utilized specialized data labeling and annotation tools to create accurate road features, lane markings, traffic signs, and environmental metadata in compliance with AV safety standards.

Performed continuous data quality monitoring and validation, ensuring completeness, consistency, and accuracy of map datasets.

Monitored system performance and data pipelines using Kibana dashboards, identifying anomalies and proactively addressing data quality issues.

Collaborated closely with AV engineers, quality assurance teams, and data scientists to support model training and improve map reliability.

Adhered to strict safety, quality, and compliance standards, contributing to the safe deployment of automated vehicle solutions.

Supported process improvements and documentation, helping improve efficiency and accuracy in mapping workflows.

Projects 

Attrition Predictive Modelling

Skills: Python, Data Visualization, Machine Learning

Project Description:

Analyzed key factors contributing to high employee attrition and suggested actionable strategies to improve retention.

Conducted Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) to understand feature distributions, correlations, and trends using Seaborn and Plotly visualizations.

Performed feature engineering and categorical encoding to prepare data for machine learning models.

Developed and compared Logistic Regression models with and without feature engineering.

Evaluated model performance using ROC curves and identified critical features influencing attrition.

IL and QA Edit Time Analysis

Skills: Python, R, Machine Learning

Role & Responsibilities:

Developed Python and R scripts to analyze Initial Labeling (IL) and QA edit times and optimize QA processes.

Project Highlights:

Monitored performance of 500 operators across 3 sites and 2 vendors, focusing on quality assurance efficiency.

Analyzed edit patterns to identify tracks prone to errors, improving QA focus and reducing unnecessary effort without impacting quality.

Conducted correlation analysis between initial edit times and QA edit times to identify efficiency bottlenecks.

Achieved high-quality results: average precision of 96% and recall of 99% in QA outputs.

Employee Performance Analysis

Skills: Python, R, Machine Learning (Linear/Logistic Regression, Decision Tree, Random Forest), KNIME

Role & Responsibilities:

Developed code in Python and R Studio to analyze historical employee performance data and implement predictive models.

Project Highlights:

Identified factors affecting employee performance, such as policy changes, tool updates, and shift changes.

Applied data mining and cleaning techniques, performed missing value imputation, and split datasets into dependent and independent variables.

Built predictive models using R Studio and KNIME, evaluated accuracy, and visualized results.

Provided actionable insights to improve employee performance and optimize HR interventions based on model predictions.

sections.text:
Projects 
Attrition Predictive Modelling
Project Highlights:
Monitored performance of 500 operators across 3 sites and 2 vendors, focusing on quality assurance efficiency.
Analyzed edit patterns to identify tracks prone to errors, improving QA focus and reducing unnecessary effort without impacting quality.
Conducted correlation analysis between initial edit times and QA edit times to identify efficiency bottlenecks.
Achieved high-quality results: average precision of 96% and recall of 99% in QA outputs.
Employee Performance Analysis
Project Highlights:
Identified factors affecting employee performance, such as policy changes, tool updates, and shift changes.
Applied data mining and cleaning techniques, performed missing value imputation, and split datasets into dependent and independent variables.
Built predictive models using R Studio and KNIME, evaluated accuracy, and visualized results.
Provided actionable insights to improve employee performance and optimize HR interventions based on model predictions.
